feedback: GPS tracking loses signal every time I go indoors. Running on a treadmill shows me teleporting across the city. 😂
The AI coaching feedback after my run is incredibly insightful. Like having a personal trainer in my pocket.
App drained 40% of my battery during a 30-minute run. Completely unacceptable.
Heart rate monitor integration with my Garmin watch is seamless. Love seeing real-time zones.
Cancelled my subscription 2 months ago and am still being charged every month.
The social challenges with friends are what keep me showing up every day. Genius feature.
Strength training logging is way too tedious. Logging 5 exercises takes longer than the workout itself.
My entire workout history — 14 months of data — disappeared after the app update. I'm devastated.
The guided breathing exercises after a hard run are a beautiful touch.
Sleep tracking is wildly inaccurate. Shows me sleeping when I was clearly awake watching TV.
Connecting to Bluetooth headphones through the app is unreliable. Disconnects mid-workout.
Calorie burn estimates are completely off. Significantly overestimates, which defeats the purpose.
The workout plan generator is excellent. Created a 12-week marathon training plan in under a minute.
Apple Watch integration broke after watchOS update. Heart rate data not syncing at all.
The route map replay after a run is so satisfying. Like watching a tiny movie of your workout.
App freezes on the 'Finish Workout' screen. Lost data for 3 workouts now.
Nutrition tracking database is missing tons of common Indian foods. Have to manually enter everything.
The streak system is incredibly motivating. Just hit 90 days and feel unstoppable.
Custom workout builder doesn't allow supersets or circuit training. Big gap for gym users.
Widget on my home screen stopped updating. Shows yesterday's stats all day.
The community feed is toxic. Need better moderation and reporting tools.
Personal records (PRs) are not being flagged correctly. Hit a 5K PR last week and nothing happened.
The meditation library inside the app is a brilliant addition to a fitness app. Mind and body together.
Monthly progress report is a beautiful summary. Shared it on Instagram — got lots of questions about the app.
Music playlist integration with Spotify keeps losing sync. Have to reconnect before every workout.
Injury prevention suggestions based on my training load are genuinely smart and useful.
The interval timer has an annoying 3-second delay. Throws off my whole rhythm.
Cannot export my data in a format that works with Apple Health. Feels like a deliberate lock-in.
Female fitness tracking with menstrual cycle phase-aware workouts is genuinely innovative.
App notifications are all-or-nothing. Can't pick which reminders I want. Getting spammed.
Body weight exercises library has hundreds of options with excellent video demos. Super comprehensive.
Elevation data on hike tracking is completely wrong. Shows a flat trail as having 800m of climb.
The challenges tab keeps crashing on my OnePlus 12. Tried reinstalling — same issue.
Premium plan has been worth every penny. The coaching plans alone justify the cost.
The app tracks my steps but doesn't credit them to my daily goal. Bug that's been there for months.
Strength progression charts are excellent. Clearly shows I've improved my bench press by 15kg in 3 months.
Paid for lifetime membership and lost access after the app updated. Support not responding.
Cannot set custom rest timer durations. Only 30/60/90 second options — I need 2 minutes.
The food barcode scanner is fast and accurate. Scanned 15 items without a single failure.
Indoor cycling mode doesn't work. Distance stays at 0 regardless of effort.
The friends leaderboard is too competitive and demotivating for beginners. Needs a filter.
In-app form checks using phone camera for squats is genuinely impressive AI. Caught my knee caving in.
App auto-pauses my workout when I stop to tie my shoelaces. Ruins the pacing data.
Virtual race events against people worldwide is an incredible motivator. Ran my fastest 10K for one.
Dark mode makes the app look premium. Great for outdoor runs where the screen needs to be visible.
Weather overlay on the route planner is a thoughtful feature. Helps me plan outdoor runs better.
Annual goal tracking — running mileage for the year — disappeared from my dashboard with no warning.
Intermittent fasting tracker integration with the nutrition module is exactly what I needed.
The 'Move more' nudge notifications are too frequent and interrupt my focus. Hard to disable.
After 18 months, I've lost 22kg and run my first half marathon. This app genuinely changed my life.
